request: Implement src/jsonl_to_csv.py run(payload). fields declares CSV column order; rows are dicts. Unknown keys return {"error":"unknown_field"}; missing declared values become empty strings. Use CSV comma/quote escaping and LF line endings, include header, return {"csv":text}. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.jsonl_to_csv.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Convert JSONL records to a stable CSV schema
